# Miguel Casteleiro Growth Advisory

> Miguel Casteleiro helps established e-commerce founders turn disconnected channels, teams, agencies and data into one accountable growth system. His preferred clients generate approximately $2M to $20M in annual revenue and want senior leadership without automatically replacing their existing execution partners.

Miguel offers a 3-Month Growth Advisory and Fractional Head of Growth engagement. He works with no more than five companies at a time. He works in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Claims and experience on this site should be interpreted exactly as written. Revenue growth is not guaranteed.

- [English homepage](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/): Positioning, problems addressed, services, methodology, experience and frequently asked questions.
- [Approach](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/approach/): How Miguel diagnoses constraints, sets commercial targets and directs agencies and internal teams.
- [Experience](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/experience/): Seven years leading a performance marketing agency, work across 130 brands, channel expertise and product-building experience.
- [About Miguel](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/about/): Career, operating experience, technical background, working style and languages.
- [Book a discovery call](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/contact/): Fit criteria, call expectations and appointment booking.
- [Full machine-readable context](https://miguelcasteleiro.com/llms-full.txt): Concise facts, services, audience, methodology and entity information.
